content: STAGE: scope + design direction. GOAL: choose a hyperbolic SID-table quality metric that is not any of the already-measured constructs. READ: the task contract, the measured list (Q_H +0.634; HBAA +0.701; all partition-geometry metrics fail; softmax path likelihood -0.488 and collapse-driven; cell expected rank +0.300; cell rank lift +0.344), and the stated opening: the winning family must use the full training history as the query point and/or the full negative distribution with a size-matched null. OBSERVED: HBAA is still a mean-margin contrast; the untried frontier is a proper conditional score over ALL level-1 cells with an explicit size prior. REASONING: propose a level-1 hyperbolic pointwise-mutual-information score: query = full-history Poincare barycentre of source reps; each level-1 cell = Poincare barycentre of its target reps; p(k|q) = softmax of negative geodesic distance at the frozen reference temperature; subtract log(n_k/N). This uses full negative distribution (log score), full history, and a size null in one scalar; collapse gives exactly 0. OPEN: no measurement possible in this session; finalize formula and failure mode.

FINAL STAGE (answer is in the reply; this record is the <=4000-char summary of it). METRIC: hyp_hist_pmi_l1. Construction: curvature -1 unit Poincare ball. Map Euclidean reference vectors e to the ball by E(e/s)=tanh(||e/s||/2) e/||e||, with s the RMS training norm derived from T; log map L(x)=2 artanh(||x||) x/||x||; geodesic barycentre B(X)=E(mean L(x)); d = Poincare distance via Moebius addition. For each level-1 code k, C_k = B of the target-side points of training items in k. For each training pair with nonempty history H_u, q_u = B of the source-side points of H_u, k_u+ = level-1 code of the positive target. p_u(k)=softmax_k(-d(q_u,C_k)/tau), tau=1/beta_ref (frozen reference inverse temperature, never tuned). Metric M = mean_u [ ln p_u(k_u+) - ln(n_k+/N) ]. This is a full-field size-matched log score: full history query, full negative distribution, size prior. One-code table -> 0; size-matched random relabel -> 0; anti-aligned table -> strongly negative. Cost O((N+|U'|)d + |U'|K d), K<=256, N=24587, vectorised, under a minute, no training/iteration. Inputs only SID level-1 codes, frozen reference source/target vectors + beta_ref, training split. No validation/test. Distinct from Q_H, HBAA (mean margin), hsoftmax path (uncorrected path likelihood), cell expected rank/lift, and all tightness/margin/coverage metrics. Risks: source-target space mismatch, tau scaling, rare-cell bonus, cold-start histories skipped, ceiling effect. FAILURE MODE: size-matched anti-aligned permutation of codes (strongly negative), or collapse/random relabel (0).
